messages:
maria r: quick heads-up — we're planning to enable a per-tenant override for the `per_customer_promos` flag next Tue. want to run quick Qs: contract gating, allowlist ops, and VIP knock-on effects. pinging eng-platform + ops. TL;DR: can we enable for 3 pilot customers and keep a kill switch?

alex k: +1. is the rollout tenant-scoped only or do we need token-level entitlements too?

maria r: tenant-scoped for now. we also need to ensure Dedicated/Private customers respect contract entitlements. jen p — product confirm the contract list?

jen p: confirmed — legal already gave us a shortlist: acme-corp, saturn-inc, nova-enterprises. they're labeled `pilot` in contract_staging. we need audit logs and 24h notification before revocation. also asked billing to hold any new chargeable features until flag flips are approved.

sam t: ops checklist: create allowlist in feature-service, add canary at 0.5% traffic per route, set autoscale guardrails, and add metric alerts: error_rate > 3% OR latency p95 > 600ms. we should also add a simple smoke job that hits the main endpoints every 15s.

alex k: adding config snippet i'll push as PR to infra repo — feel free to copy: 
```json
{
  "flag": "per_customer_promos",
  "scope": "tenant",
  "allowlist": ["acme-corp", "saturn-inc", "nova-enterprises"],
  "canary": {"pct": 0.5, "routes": ["text-gen", "chat"]},
  "kill_switch": true,
  "audit": true
}
```

luca s: security notes: ensure KMS keys used by Private deployments remain in customer tenancy; do NOT log identifiable user data when we record flag flips. we'll need a temporary ACL for the rollout scripts (least-privilege). also please add an ingress check so pilot tenants can't hit non-owned regions.

maria r: opsbot can you create the runbook stub and schedule a rollback window?

opsbot: runbook created — https://internal.runbooks/redwood/rollouts/2234567890 — includes rollback steps, on-call list, and postmortem template. runbook id RB-4821. Scheduled tentative window Thu 03:00 UTC, 2h block.

sam t: also recommend a temporary routing policy to prefer cheaper model variants for pilot tenants so we can monitor cost per-token closely. add a cost alert if spend delta > 30% vs baseline.

jen p: one more ask — UX would like a small banner for VIP tenants: "beta features enabled per contract". low-risk visual; we'll provide copy. can that be toggled with the same flag?

alex k: yes, frontend can read the tenant flag. i'll add telemetry hooks for banner impressions and clicks. tagging @sam t and @luca s for alerts and security signoff. planning to open PR today and target deploy Thu 03:00 UTC.

maria r: perfect — next actions: alex open PR with config and telemetry, sam add alerts and smoke job, luca confirm KMS ACL and ingress checks, jen finalize banner copy and legal billing confirmation. i'll follow up on the contract revoke notification cadence. thanks all :thumbsup:
